ITEM 1 | Three flattened, pale golden-beige pieces of cooked meat or fish-like protein, roughly 4-5 cm long and 2-3 cm wide each, arranged in a loose overlapping cluster in the upper-left center of a white square plate; surface shows light tan browning with small orange-brown flecks and dark seared edges on the bottom, moist and slightly flaky with a soft, non-glossy sheen, holding shape | 150
ITEM 2 | Cooked dark green leafy vegetable with thick pale-green stems, roughly 8-9 cm across, piled in a mound on the lower-right of the plate beside the protein; leaves are wilted, glossy and moist with some darker green folds, stems are crisp-looking, pale green and translucent at the cut ends | 90
